payload.summary: Greptile on PR #105 (MAR-2922): when documenting that several CLI positionals form one search query, the dash rule must cover every query word, not only the first.
payload.mistake: The contract said to use -- before a query beginning with a dash, but node:util parseArgs also treats a later unquoted word such as -output as an option.
guidance: Tell callers to put -- before the query whenever any query argument begins with a dash.
Back each documented CLI argument form with a behavioural CLI test.

searchText: CLI search positional query dash terminator parseArgs documentation Greptile
subject: review.cli-argument-documentation
